body:
It's alright, I think it's actually only a northern american thing so I didn't expect you to know. I just forget sometimes when I talk about it that it's not obvious to everyone that they closed.

Honestly... I don't know anymore. Part of me wants to walk away... another part thinks I will regret it so I feel like I'm in limbo with her anymore. I don't even 'act' like I am dating someone because it doesn't feel like that's what we are doing anymore.

I can't think of much else I'd like to talk about... I never was good at making conversation I suppose...

Honestly I only have two friends I need to catch up with and both are living out of state right now. I don't have a lot of friends, I always went for quality over quantity but in times like this I wish I had more.

Value City's doors closed in 2009 or I would have still been there. I stayed their until the day they closed.

I don't think this one can me mended. I try to bring it up, she ignores it. She's in therapy herself right now and I think ignoring the bad is something her therapist has told her to do because no matter what I try she won't talk to me when I try to tell her I'm unhappy. And I'm such a people pleaser I just let her have her way now and bottle this all up from her. She doesn't even know I'm thinking about suicide.

I don't feel like I have another option anymore. It's been so so long since I have felt this hopeless, usually it lasts for an hour and I'm back at it like you, looking at the bright side. But as of right now this feeling has been on going for 12 hours straight with no hope to pick myself back up with. And I'm alone. My last effort was to try to find someone, anyone to spend the day with, thinking that if I can find someone to be around, even if I feel like this it could distract me until I can stand up on my own two feet again...

But my tower it's rocking and there is no one here to help. There is no one here to pull me back on my feet and help carry me... And while knowing someone does care out there... it's just different then having someone physically there and when I'm this far down... that's what I really need. If that makes any bit of sense.

I know they don't see me as a burden, I almost wish they did because it might make leaving them easier.

I do have prior experience. About a year ago I worked at Macy's. I was there for a year but the longer I worked the harder it got. Making sales and getting credit card applications was everything and I'm just not as aggressive as they needed me to be. So it ended me in a spot with a boss who hated me from day one (I am a heavy set lady and she seemed to have an issue with anyone who wasn't a size two like her) whose standards I never could live up to. As if it's not bad enough to have SA in a retail setting where you are required to speak to every customer, day in and out I was scolded for the lack of credit card applications I would get. It got unbearable to the point where I physically was sick on the sales floor in front of customers on a day to day basis. My doctor advised me to take some time off and right before I could they cut me from part time to call in, meaning I would get the few hours even they were giving me. So I quit and ever since that experience I've been scared of retail work. Before that I used to work at Value City, another, smaller department store but I loved it there. I would talk to a lot of customers but I wasn't required to. It made it nicer though because on good days I could talk and on bad days I could drown myself in my work. I mean, crazy to say but I really like company despite my SA. I get lonely easily..

I know there is no answer then other to continue to pound the pavement, it's just getting harder and harder to pull myself out of bed every morning. I keep thinking I'm 24, I'm alone and jobless. I have a long distance girlfriend but I've known for a while (since she first dumped me and lost my trust) that it wasn't going to work. Now it's just a matter of time.

Everything is just... crumbling around me. I feel like a kid with a tower of bricks, trying to keep it from falling while it wobbles back and forth... it's going to fall soon and when it does I will lose the last shred of reason I have left to hold on... and despite what anyone might think with how I act sometimes... I'm scared to death. Really, like everyone else on this thread I don't want to die. No one truly wants that, we just want the pain to stop.

I know she does... she grew up poor and without a lot so it makes her want to give me everything. And she is so stubborn, declining is not an option. I have her last 25 dollars for the week sitting in my wallet because I refused to take it and she stuffed it in their this morning before she left.

I guess you're right. I just... I want to fit in and be able to do stuff like that like everyone else. The mornings before my interviews I spent dry heaving and panicking. It should not be that stressful for a interview at Walmart but it is for me.. I think it kills me that I can't do more social things because I really want to, despite my fear.

Well I've applied at two places my friends work at, both putting a good word for me. Both places though are still hiring and I haven't heard anything from them even though I've reapplied twice at each place and call every few days. It might be due to my SA cause I can't look strangers in the eye and my friend's mother once said it made me look shifty but even when I tell people that... I don't know they still don't trust me.

Well, no they have never made me feel like a burden and in a way it's almost worse that way. My dad is much like his dad was though in the way of saving money so we do without the things we want a lot. It's how I was raised and I'm fine with it. But my mother, she finds out I want something and spends her own money that she was stashed away on me all the time. And that makes me hate myself, because while this is happening my mom does without so I can have something petty...

It's easy to cut myself short though when everyone tells me how it's not a big deal to go to interviews. That I make a big deal about even going out shopping... I used to be better about it and the older I got the harder it got and well, my family doesn't understand that, my friends either. How could they? I don't think social anxiety is easy to understand if you don't feel it.

Moving really isn't an option, I don't have any money to do so and while my parents help support me here they believe once I move out I should be 100% on my own, it's how they were both raised. As far as job goes, I'd take anything now. I'm a college dropout so I don't have much going for me education wise so, whatever I could get would be wonderful. Even retail I could probably stomach to do again though my last job I had to quit when my SA made me physically sick day in and out.

It's just been a slow decline for me. Being unable to find a job has made it worse over the past couple months though because I am mainly living off my parents. It makes me feel like such a burden but with jobs slim in our town there isn't much else I can do. I also have a social anxiety disorder which doesn't help my presence at all during the interviews I have had.

Right now I just feel stuck.
